text: GETTING STARTED Function List [图标]Copy page [图标] Vidu API currently supports multiple functions, covering various development scenarios such as video, audio, images, and creative applications. The function list is continuously updated: [图标] Primary Secondary Function Details Video Image to Video Generate video from input image and prompts- Supports free selection of video ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude- Supports adding background music- Supports multiple generation modes Reference to Video Use input images’ subjects or scenes as references to generate video- Supports uploading multiple images- Supports free selection of video ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude- Supports adding background music- Supports multiple generation modes Start end to video Input first and last frame, generate video with prompts- Supports free selection of video ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude- Supports adding background music- Supports multiple generation modes Text to Video Generate video directly from prompts- Supports long text input- Supports free selection of video ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude- Supports adding background music- Supports multiple generation modes Real-Time Interactive Digital Character Avatar Real-Time Input: Images, persona settings, and the user’s audio/video for real-time conversation.Real-time interaction: the digital human talks with users in real time, supports interruptions, and provides bidirectional perception. Vidu S provides the complete pipeline from voice input to rendering. Avatar Component Input: Reference digital human audio + motion text to generate real-time video.Real-time interaction: bring your own RTC channel and real-time voice capabilities. Vidu S handles the digital human rendering and streams the output to your channel. Avatar Non-Real-Time Input: The user’s audio/video stream + a replacement reference image to generate real-time video.Streaming video editing: continuously receive a video stream and output the edited result in real time. You can change the reference image or switch scenes during the session without interrupting the stream. Editing Input: The user’s audio/video stream + a replacement reference image to generate real-time video.Streaming video editing: continuously receive a video stream and output the edited result in real time. You can change the reference image or switch scenes during the session without interrupting the stream. Audio Text to Audio Generate audio directly from prompts- Supports generating creative sound effects or background music- Supports free selection of audio duration Timing to Audio Generate controllable sequential sound effects from prompts- Use a timeline to flexibly control the order and duration of multiple sound effects- Supports overlapping multiple sound effects- Supports free selection of audio duration Text to Speech Generate speech from text- Control speech speed, pauses, volume, and polyphonic characters- Adjust emotional tone (e.g., joyful, sad, angry)- Supports 30+ languages and 300+ voices Voice Clone Upload audio to clone voice timbre- Use cloned voices anytime for speech synthesis- Adjust emotional tone freely Template Template Apply templates to images to generate videos- Includes hundreds of creative templates: e-commerce, virtual try-on, transformation, etc. Template Story Apply long template story to images to generate videos- Storylines are coherent and effects are diverse Others Lip Sync Make video character lip-sync to the specified text- Supports hundreds of voices and languages- Supports long text input- Supports adjusting volume freely Video Extension Extend the duration of videos- Supports extension from 1～7s Multi-Frame Generate storyline-consistent, character-consistent videos from multiple keyframes- Flexible control of frame-to-frame duration (2–7s)- Each frame can be guided by prompts Prompt Recommendations Generate recommended prompts from images- Supports selecting prompt type and quantity- Supports selecting video resolution Upscale Pro Enhance video resolution- Supports multiple resolutions: 1080p, 2K, 4K, 8K
